description: This Java source file defines the ModelRelation class, which models a <relation> element in the OFBiz entity framework. It includes methods for creating, accessing, and serializing relation metadata such as relation type, related entity, foreign key, and key mappings.

classes.name: ModelRelation
classes.description: An immutable class representing a relation between entities in OFBiz, including relation type, related entity, foreign key, key mappings, and serialization to XML.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate ModelRelation with explicit parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate ModelRelation from an XML element.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate ModelRelation from database reference info.

methods.name: getCombinedName
methods.description: Returns a combined name (title + related entity name).

methods.name: getRelEntityName
methods.description: Returns the name of the related entity.

methods.name: getKeyMaps
methods.description: Returns the list of key mappings.

methods.name: isAutoRelation
methods.description: Indicates if the relation was auto-generated.

methods.name: findKeyMap
methods.description: Finds a key map by field name.

methods.name: findKeyMapByRelated
methods.description: Finds a key map by related field name.

methods.name: toXmlElement
methods.description: Serializes the relation to an XML element.

methods.name: keyMapString
methods.description: Returns a string of key field names separated by a separator, ending with afterLast.

methods.name: keyMapUpperString
methods.description: Returns a string of key field names with first character uppercased, separated by a separator, ending with afterLast.

methods.name: keyMapRelatedUpperString
methods.description: Returns a string of related key field names with first character uppercased, separated by a separator, ending with afterLast.
